device.description: 12-bit 20 kHz micropower sampling ADC with 3-wire serial interface
device.note: ads1286.pdf (SBAS031) p.2 specifications and timing characteristics, p.2 pin configuration and assignments, p.8 operating sequence (Figure 1), p.9 serial interface and shutdown

pages: p.2 (specifications, timing, pins), p.8 (Figure 1 operating sequence), p.9 (serial interface)
notModeled: analog input; the conversion is clocked by DCLOCK (12 clocks, not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once)

DOUT is Hi-Z for the first two DCLOCK edges (sample time 1.5-2.0 clocks), then the null bit, then B11..B0; after B0 the part outputs the result LSB-first and/or zeros (Figure 1 notes 1 and 2; all zeros for the 0 V code, so idle 0 covers it)
automatic power-down after each conversion and shutdown while CS/SHDN is high (no visible bus effect)
throughput (20 kHz max) and DCLOCK frequency limits
variants: ADS1286 grades U (0-70 C), UA/UB/UC (-40 to 85 C, accuracy grades), UL; same chip
